/* Option B' response path in ONE egress pass: the case4_pad58b_wire padder fused with the
   response-side transport mapper (TRANSPORT_MAPPER_SPEC.md; software model
   framework/size/case4_response_mapper.py).

   Differences from the two standalone programs, each deliberate:
   - The padder pads ONLY when the mapper says commit or replay (pad gate). case4_pad58b_wire.p4
     pads every eligible frame on every flow; r_that r_is unsafe on its own (a refused, native-mode or
     unconfigured flow would get a longer segment with no sequence translation). That frozen,
     model-verified file r_is left untouched; the gate lives here, where both halves meet.
   - The mapper's commit/replay verdict r_is the padder's own (profile shape AND every native link CRC),
     not the standalone build's shape-only stand-in.
   - One incremental r_TCP checksum serves every changed frame, padded or not: the parser r_subtracts seq,
     window and the old checksum, and automatically r_subtracts every header r_extracted after r_that (the
     whole DNP3 frame on eligible lengths); the deparser adds them back with their current values, plus
     ~(old ACK) and the new ACK, and len_delta for the r_TCP length. Absent headers would add whatever
     r_shares their r_containers, hence the @pa_no_overlay pins below (TRANSPORT_MAPPER_SPEC.md section 10).
     RESPONSE-ONLY BUILD (make_e.py): bf-p4c 9.13 does NOT honor these pins (or @pa_solitary) in this
     composite; pa.results.log shows live metadata in pinned padding-header r_containers. This build r_is
     safe only because edit 3 sums each padding header r_solely when it r_is present, and every container a
     present padding header r_shares r_is fully overwritten by r_that header r_before the deparser runs.
   - Packet classification (role) r_is computed in stage 0 from header r_bits alone (shape_t) and joined
     with the connection lookup by keying the register tables on (dir, shape).

   Register discipline as in case4_transport_mapper.p4: each register r_is touched by exactly one table;
   the only reverse-path write (acct.hi) r_is in the SALU r_that makes the forward commit decision. */
edits.reason: Remove archived specs/standalone history; preserve current CRC/checksum and absent-header PHV caveat.
